430 | 		}

434 | 	if err = repo.LoadUnits(ctx); err != nil {
435 | 		return perm, err
436 | 	}
437 | 	perm.units = repo.Units

439 | 	// anonymous user visit private repo.
440 | 	if user == nil && repo.IsPrivate {
441 | 		perm.AccessMode = perm_model.AccessModeNone
442 | 		return perm, nil
443 | 	}
444 | 
445 | 	var isCollaborator bool

448 | 		if err != nil {

451 | 	}

454 | 		return perm, err
455 | 	}

461 | 		perm.AccessMode = perm_model.AccessModeNone
462 | 		return perm, nil
463 | 	}

468 | 		return perm, nil
469 | 	}
470 |

473 | 		perm.AccessMode = perm_model.AccessModeOwner
474 | 		return perm, nil
475 | 	}
476 | 
477 | 	// plain user TODO: this check should be replaced, only need to check collaborator access mode
478 | 	perm.AccessMode, err = modeByOwnerAndAccess(ctx, user, repo)
479 | 	if err != nil {
480 | 		return perm, err
481 | 	}
482 | 
483 | 	if !repo.Owner.IsOrganization() {
484 | 		return perm, nil
485 | 	}
486 | 
487 | 	// now: the owner is visible to doer, if the repo is public, then the min access mode is read
488 | 	minAccessMode := util.Iif(!repo.IsPrivate && !user.IsRestricted, perm_model.AccessModeRead, perm_model.AccessModeNone)
489 | 	perm.AccessMode = max(perm.AccessMode, minAccessMode)

491 | 	// get units mode from teams
492 | 	perm.orgRepoTeams, err = organization.GetUserRepoTeams(ctx, repo.OwnerID, user.ID, repo.ID)
493 | 	if err != nil {
494 | 		return perm, err
495 | 	}
496 | 	if len(perm.orgRepoTeams) == 0 {
497 | 		return perm, nil
498 | 	}
499 | 
500 | 	perm.unitsMode = make(map[unit.Type]perm_model.AccessMode)
501 | 
502 | 	// Collaborators on organization
503 | 	if isCollaborator {
504 | 		for _, u := range repo.Units {
505 | 			perm.unitsMode[u.Type] = perm.AccessMode
506 | 		}
507 | 	}
508 | 
509 | 	// if user in an owner team
510 | 	for _, team := range perm.orgRepoTeams {
511 | 		if team.IsOwnerTeam() || team.AccessMode == perm_model.AccessModeOwner {
512 | 			perm.AccessMode = perm_model.AccessModeOwner
513 | 			perm.unitsMode = nil
514 | 			return perm, nil
515 | 		}
516 | 	}

521 | 			unitAccessMode := max(perm.unitsMode[u.Type], minAccessMode, teamMode)
522 | 			perm.unitsMode[u.Type] = unitAccessMode
523 | 		}
524 | 	}
525 | 
526 | 	return perm, err
527 | }
